article.title: AWS Quick接入Meta廣告，把活動與商業資料放進同一流程
article.title_en: AWS Quick connects Meta ads with business data
article.summary: AWS宣布Quick加入Meta ads AI連接器，讓團隊以自然語言建立、管理及分析廣告活動。
article.summary_en: AWS added a Meta ads AI connector to Quick for natural-language campaign creation, management and analysis.
highlights: 廣告資料可與第一方及第三方資料組合成儀表板、文件及簡報。
連接時需選擇Quick可存取的專頁、企業及Instagram帳戶。
highlights_en: Meta ads data can be combined with first- and third-party sources in dashboards, documents and slides.
Connection setup selects the Pages, Businesses and Instagram accounts Quick may access.
article.why: 媒體團隊可把廣告表現與庫存、毛利等商業資料並列，決定哪些商品需要調整預算，再準備供人員審閱的變更。
article.why_en: Media teams can compare performance with stock and margin before proposing budget shifts for review.
article.next_step: 先以一組商品活動與獲授權庫存表建立比較，要求只提出預算建議，再核對活動、商品及金額後決定是否修改。
article.next_step_en: Compare one product campaign with authorized inventory data, request proposals only, then reconcile products, campaigns and amounts.
article.detail: AWS的示例包含分析表現、整理商品目錄及準備活動計劃，部分動作要求先批准。MCP是讓AI助理連接外部工具的協定，實際可做哪些操作仍取決於帳戶授權。團隊可先限定一個商品系列，追查分析資料如何連到活動設定，確保建議使用的商品及商業指標有清楚對應。
article.detail_en: AWS illustrates performance analysis, catalog work and campaign planning, with approval in selected workflows. MCP connects AI assistants with external tools; actions depend on account authorization. Trace one product line from business data to campaign settings before applying changes.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
